api.notes: Number attribute; clamped to 0..max, non-finite counts as 0.
Required for accessibility; names the progressbar via aria-labelledby.
Array of {value, label}; property only. Values outside 0..max clamp to the track edges.
Visual only, as upstream; the progressbar keeps its semantics and is not aria-disabled.

api.reason: A-ref: the element itself is the ref; the track is reachable as part="track".
A-xstyle family: data-* attributes are set on the host directly; nothing to map.
A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base|label|value-label|track|fill|mark) or the tokens.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to each target mark in order; the mark label is its accessible name.

differences.text: Fills are Tecton roles: accent uses --tecton-color-progress-primary on --color-track; success, warning and error use the filled status roles; neutral uses the neutral status role. Disabled greys fill and text.
Marks are rendered beside the progressbar, not inside it, as focusable role=img elements named by their label, so the progressbar's children stay presentational and axe accepts the tree.
The default value text is the percentage formatted with Intl.NumberFormat for the element's language (via LocaleController) instead of a fixed string.

provisional: Mark tooltips: the mark label is the accessible name today, and the hover/focus tooltip (upstream placement above, focusTrigger always) is added with tct-tooltip when it lands.
core.progress-bar.notes: Guides: [mwg:progress-ring] native <progress> not used (cannot carry marks or custom value text); [mwg:spinner] reduced-motion slowdown; [mwg:css] --_animation-reduced and forced colours; [mwg:accessible-web-components] ids in one root.
